feed.description: Flat 10W charging pad with a woven fabric top and a non-slip base. Charges through most cases. Status LED dims automatically at night. USB-C input, adapter sold separately.

feed.title: Voltaire Duo Charging Stand
feed.description: Upright stand that charges a phone and earbuds at the same time. Adjustable 45 to 70 degree viewing angle, so face unlock still works while it charges. Aluminium frame with a silicone cradle.

feed.title: Nimbus Mini Charging Puck

feed.title: Anvil 100W USB-C Cable 2m
feed.description: 2 metre 100W USB-C cable with an E-marker chip for full laptop charging. Kevlar-reinforced core, machined aluminium housings and a 90 degree connector that sits flat against a laptop edge.
feed.warning: Data transfer is 480Mbps. Not a display or Thunderbolt cable.

feed.title: Pocket USB-C Cable 30cm
feed.description: 30 centimetre USB-C cable sized for power banks and car chargers, so there is no loose loop on the seat. 60W rated, silicone jacket that stays soft in cold weather.
feed.warning: Short length is intended for power banks, not wall sockets.

feed.title: Cellar 10000mAh Power Bank
feed.description: 10000mAh power bank with 22.5W output and pass-through charging. Recharges fully in 3.5 hours over USB-C. Four-LED charge indicator.
feed.warning: Airline rules permit this capacity in cabin baggage only.

feed.title: Portway 7-in-1 USB-C Hub
feed.description: Seven port USB-C hub with 4K HDMI at 60Hz, three USB-A ports, SD and microSD readers and 100W pass-through charging. Aluminium shell that runs cool under load.
feed.warning: 4K at 60Hz requires a host that supports DisplayPort Alt Mode.

feed.title: Pulse Mini Bluetooth Speaker
feed.description: Palm-sized Bluetooth speaker with a passive radiator for low end you can actually hear. 12 hours playback, IP67 dust and water rating, pairs to a second unit for stereo.
feed.warning: IP67 rated. Rinse with fresh water after use near salt water.

feed.title: DeskRise Aluminium Laptop Stand
feed.description: Folding aluminium laptop stand with six height positions, lifting the screen to eye level. Holds up to 8kg. Silicone pads front and rear. Folds to 2cm for a bag.

feed.title: Shieldskin Clear Phone Case
feed.description: Clear TPU case with a raised camera lip and reinforced corners rated to a 2 metre drop. Anti-yellowing coating. Compatible with magnetic wireless charging.
feed.warning: Clear cases discolour over time. Coating slows this, it does not stop it.
